items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: he had Stan Getz in the reed section

ctx.x: But the movie band was a great band; he had Stan Getz in the reed section, because during a lot of the solo work and in the smaller groups doing solo, he had Urbie Green in the trombone section, the soundtrack, and also photographed along with some of the small group sessions. Of course, the original quartet was in the movie -- Lionel was there and Gene Krupa and myself, and we were all photographed because we did our own sound tracks. And I'm trying to think if there was anyone else that you know very well who…
Did Benny's brother go out there at all?
